snippet.title: The Curse of Kubel+ - Expansion DLC - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
With the discovery of the ruins within the Kaldestan Chasm, many brave adventurers have gathered in search of riches and glory. Unfortunately, the deadly Kubel's Disease has returned and the Magician's Guild has sent out Magetano, a talented mage, to seek out and seal the forbidden book that appears with the disease.
